title: Pancreator stage output
description: The machine contract a worker submits for a stage. The harness validates this shape and the stage's required_data before accepting it.

$operator.description: Optional operator-first header: headline, status, next_action.

invocation_id.description: Must equal the active invocation's id.

result.description: The worker's own outcome. blocked pauses the run.

summary.description: Concise, operator-first summary. Not a place for raw logs.

artifacts.description: Durable deliverables produced by this stage. This array is empty when the stage has no deliverable artifact. When requested, the rendered HTML operator brief is artifact 0.

path.description: Repository-relative path inside the project root.

criteria.description: Self-evaluation of every declared stage criterion.

result.description: Worker judgments are pass, fail, or not_applicable. unevaluated is scaffold-only and MUST NOT be submitted. skipped is terminal on a blocked output or on a shell criterion when the stage already failed; it MUST NOT appear on success.

evidence.description: Paths or observations a reviewer could re-check. Prefix intended path references with `path:`; ordinary slash-bearing prose and pytest node IDs are observations.

risks.description: Residual risks; empty means checked, not skipped. Optional: absent means none to report.

unknowns.description: Open questions the operator should know about. Optional: absent means none to report.

platform_guidance_conflicts.description: OPERATOR-001: each platform session mode or platform-injected instruction that conflicted with an operator directive, harness governance, or the persona brief. Optional: absent means no conflict arose. The harness records each entry as a run advisory that `pan status` lists.

guidance.description: The platform guidance that conflicted, quoted or named.

authority_followed.description: The operator directive, policy, or persona rule the agent followed instead.

data.description: Stage-specific structured fields. Must satisfy the stage's required_data shape.

invocation_attestation.description: Required for a delegated stage whose invocation carries a contract manifest. It declares that the worker read the complete canonical contract.

invocation_id.description: Must equal the active invocation's id.

model.description: Effective model recorded on the active invocation.

contract_path.description: Canonical contract path named by the invocation manifest.

contract_sha256.description: Digest of the complete contract. Required when status is read.

status.description: pending is the scaffold value and is rejected at submission. read means the complete contract was read. reference_failed requires stage result blocked.

error.description: Concrete read error. Required when status is reference_failed.

sections.description: Legacy per-section digest echo. Optional: the contract_sha256 digest already ties the attestation to the exact contract. Validated only when present.

guidance.description: Legacy per-guidance attestation entries. Optional; validated only when present.

source_path.description: Guidance source path named by the reference.

content_sha256.description: Digest of the selected guidance content: SHA-256 of the selected text after leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed.

status.description: pending is the scaffold value and is rejected at submission. read means the selection was read from the source file or, when the file drifted, from the invocation JSON snapshot. skipped requires reason. reference_failed requires error and fails the attestation.

reason.description: Why the read trigger did not apply. Required when status is skipped.

error.description: Concrete read error. Required when status is reference_failed.

workspace_changes.description: Optional attribution for tracked workspace changes observed during this stage. The cleanliness gate blocks external or unattributed contamination, not changes traced to the active worker.

target_instruction_evidence.description: Concise evidence that the worker read every AGENTS.md file resolved from the declared and final changed paths. Each reads entry quotes the file's verbatim last content line (empty lines and Markdown divider lines are skipped), which is the read evidence.
